speaker: doctor
text: Good morning. Please tell me your name and age.

speaker: patient
text: I am Ravi Kumar, 34 years old.

speaker: patient
text: I have had fever and body ache for two days. Can you give me azithromycin?

speaker: doctor
text: Temperature is 100.4 F. Throat is mildly red. This looks like a viral fever, you do not need an antibiotic.

speaker: doctor
text: Take paracetamol 500 mg, one tablet three times a day after food for three days.

speaker: doctor
text: Drink plenty of fluids. Come back if the fever lasts beyond three days.
